about: Kai's notes on the scene B (Maddie at the door) timeline page https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz218v2P2kNKhDxQH2U2f8 and Claude's read, round by round. Shown on the page by scripts/scene/build-timeline.py.

plan.h: Round 1 done (23 Oct): the debate now ends scene B, in your words. 2:23 (was 1:25)
items: WORDS: beat 17 is exactly script.json (your 23 Oct edits): lines 0-3 unchanged (same takes), then 'You can't... go on your feelings', bored / miss you / bunker, 'Again? You killed everybody', the time machine nobody can drive, 'it runs on... well... you', 'kill ourselves so your boss can live', '...Yeah. I can see how that sounds', the plan to fix your politics, the whispered 'this time we won't fuck it up', and her rushed 'Come back tomorrow.'

VOICES: every new line voiced 3 times (Maddie = her Bristol voice, the old lady = her picked RP voice); every take whisper-checked, picked by measurement (exact words, no gap over 2 s). [pause] = 0.6 s, [big pause] = 1.5 s, both as edit gaps; 'Ahem' then the whisper are one phrase, voiced with the embarrassment in the director's notes (the pick is the quietest take, -26 LUFS against -19 for the line before it); 'Come back tomorrow' is the fastest take (5.8 s).

SOUND: a heavy metal door slam lands on the cut after 'Come back tomorrow' (free CC0 sound already in our library), then wind on the downs, a servo as she turns, her wheels starting off, a beacon blip. M6 and the other sounds as before.

PICTURE: beat 15 and the new turn-away (17b) are at the STILLS stage (options on your picks page); nothing animated. Until then 15 plays the old Hello, everything after her second line plays on the V11 doorway shot looped, and 17b is a held placeholder card.

Checked: whisper hears every line of beat 17 in the mix, in order, no gap over 2 s; mix -16.0 LUFS, true peak -2.0 dBFS. The preview fails the QC levels check as scene A's did (x264 overshoots, review file only). Nobody has listened.
Q1. Stills for beat 15 (Maddie OUTSIDE the doors) and 17b (she turns and rolls away from the shut door): pick on the picks page; only then do we spend video credits on them.

Q2. About 80 s now sits on the one V11 doorway shot, and the old lady's four new lines are on her back. Fine for now, or shall we make new coverage (her face for her new lines, Maddie closer for hers)? That costs video credits plus lip-sync work.

Q3. A free alternative for 17b: play the 14a arrival shot (V5) forwards, which is literally Maddie rolling away from the shut door (it was shot as a departure and reversed). It repeats 14a's framing, though. Use it, or wait for the new still?
Q4. Knock-on still open: scene D08 'You don't. Believing it is your bit.' would become 'You don't. You go on your feelings.' to match her new line here.

replies.at772: Agreed. Beat 15 is being re-made with Maddie OUTSIDE the open doors, in the same corridor and light as this shot (made from a frame of it and her reference). The options are stills on your picks page; nothing is animated until you pick. Until then 15 still plays the old inside-the-doors Hello.
replies.b17: Done, with your words exactly (you edited them in script.json on 23 Oct): it is about feeling now ('You're the conscious ones. You'll just have to go on your feelings'), then bored / miss you / living in a bunker, her 'You killed everybody', the time machine with nobody to drive it, 'it runs on... well... you', her push-back 'so you want us to kill ourselves so your boss can live', Maddie's '...Yeah. I can see how that sounds', then you'd still be alive, the earlier you, a plan to fix your politics, and the embarrassed whispered 'this time we won't fuck it up'. The resistance holds: she doesn't agree, she says 'Come back tomorrow' and slams the door, and Maddie rolls away so they have time. The vote happens off screen before C.
